minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, September 18th, 2024

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order
  at: 10:00 AM on Wednesday, September 18th,2024.

  Members present: Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan, Scott Snider, Terry Kistler,
  George Borst.

  Members Absent: Jenny Jolly.

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Director, Armando
  Cisneros, Community Services Specialist, Robyn Olsen, Community
  Services Specialist.

  It was moved by Edward Padgett and seconded by Scott Snider to approve the
  minutes of the Wednesday, August 21st, 2024 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Valerie Smith, Lead Care Coordinator, AMFT, CTRI.

  Valerie gave an update on the CTRI program here at the La Verne Community
  Center. She informed the group that there is 8 people interested in and
  participating in the therapy program. The program is once a month on the last
  Thursday of the month from 12:30PM-5:00PM. The participants age ranges from
  young adults (18-26) to Seniors. They also other weekly sessions on zoom. The
  Staff includes 1 intern, 1 MSW that will be starting this month, and 1 Family
  Speaker/Therapist.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 523 Meals were served to an average of 23 participants in
  August.

  Meals on Wheels: 636 Meals were served/delivered in August.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account through September 18th, 2024
  was $400.00. Deposit of $400.00. Liabilities to Bingo West was $150.00.
  average attendance for August was 50 players per week.

5. Account Balance: $1052.43.
 6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid for August except Bridge.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Registration for Winter/Spring classes will be on 11/22/24 from
  11:30AM-1:30PM. Mt. Sac Classes will be offering fee-based classes in the next
  weeks.

8. Aging Next: 7 La Verne residents were served in August.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: No Updates. The Community Center will be decorating soon
  for Fall/Halloween.

10. Upcoming Events:

  •  Tuesday, September 19th – Excursion, Colorful Songs of Broadway, Your Hit Parade, 10:45AM-
  4:30PM.
  •  Tuesday, September 24th – Health and Resource Fair and Flu and Covid Shot Clinic, 9:00AM-
  11:30AM.
  •  Wednesday, October 2nd – Senior Seminar, Medicare Information, Presented by The Informed Group,
  9:30AM.
  •  Monday, October 7th – Excursion, The Huntington Library, Art Museum and Botanical Gardens, Estate
  Tour, 9:00AM-4:00PM.
  •  Wednesday, October 9th – Senior Seminar, Diabetes, Presented by Independence at Home, 9:30AM.
  •  Saturday, October 12th – Trunk or Treat event, 5:00PM-8:00PM.
  •  Monday, October 14th – Movie Matinee, Ghostbusters Afterlife, 12:30PM.

  Public Comments: Scott Snider announced that the Arts and Crafts show held at
  Hillcrest was a success. Yvonne mentioned the Senior Craft Fair being a
  success. Planning on more in the future. Robyn gave flyers and invited the
  group to a performance that will be at the Ford Theatre in Los Angeles on
  September 28th.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:45AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, October 16th, 2024.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Community Services Specialist
